Cubic Bezier Architect

Physics for the Web

Default CSS easing (`ease-in-out`) is boring. To make UI feel "alive" or "snappy," you need custom velocity curves.
Drag the pink handles to shape the acceleration. Steep lines = fast movement. Flat lines = slow movement.

cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)
